## GET /v1/kroger/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the first 24 Kroger products for a keyword search, in Kroger's order: the product id (the UPC, `product.id`), name, brand, description, product link, images, the price in US dollars with the regular price when the item is on sale, and stock (In stock or Out of stock). `product.ext.kroger` adds the pack size and, when store_id was sent, the store. Pass store_id for one store's prices and stock. Only the first page is available.

**Use when** you want to check grocery prices and stock, for one store when you pass its store id.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - The source answers the first 24 matches of a Kroger search only; refine the query for other products.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Product keywords, 1 to 200 characters, for example milk. · e.g. `milk`
- `store_id` (optional, string) - Kroger store id (digits, as in the store's page link) whose prices and stock to read. Without it the price is Kroger's default online price.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` | Product description. |

+5 more (types in the full schema): `product` {image_urls}; `product.ext` {kroger}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}. Never filled: `product.rating.average`, `product.rating.count`, `product.reviews_count`, `product.seller`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/kroger/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=milk" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## Withdrawn endpoints (do not call)

These stay registered but return `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` today and never bill. A permanent withdrawal is not coming back - use the alternative named in the platform's other endpoints rather than retrying.

- `GET /v1/kroger/product` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
